text:
alex: Hey — need a greenlight to request a burst L4 pool + a few H100s in GCP for project redwood-ml-prod-02. Target regions: us-west1 (primary) and europe-west4 (failover).
maya: rough numbers?
alex: planning initial request: L4 quota 64 GPUs in us-west1, H100 quota 8 in europe-west4, and 60 external IPs for the pool (we need static EIPs for node public egress).
raj: can we avoid EIPs by NAT? Egress rules/costs will differ.
alex: we tried NAT but some partners need static IPs for allowlisting. Also some infra tools need reachable control plane endpoints.
francesco: cost check — ballpark monthly incremental: L4 burst pool ~ $6k, H100 reserved burst ~ $3k, IPs and egress ~ $800. Total ~ $9.8k/mo. Need cost center and approval.
francesco: tagging question — which billing code?
alex: use billing code ML-OPS-2026, chargeback to product infra.
infra-bot: support-ticket created: GCP Quota Increase Request #INC-2026-442. Link: https://gcp.console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-ml-prod-02 (see ticket comments).
maya: please paste the exact gcloud payload you used so we can reproduce.
alex: here — gcloud request snippet:
```
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=redwood-ml-prod-02 --format=json
# then open quota request: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-ml-prod-02
```
raj: also add these in the quota request comments: need L4 (accelerator type L4) with 'quota type: ACCELERATORS' and 'reason: inference fleet burst for internal E2E tests + customer beta'.
maya: network ask: increase 'Static Addresses' quota to 60 in both regions and raise 'VM instances' quota for n1-highmem-32 to 40 (we use these for controller nodes).
francesco: finance needs an explicit monthly estimate and whether any of this is preemptible.
alex: L4 nodes will be mixed preemptible for background batch; 20% preemptible for cost saving. H100 will be non-preemptible for latency-critical clients. Updated estimate: $7.2k/month if 20% preemptible assumption.
sre: make sure to request quota with 'accelerator type filter' and include project owner's contact. Also request VPC peering egress limits increased for peering partner if we push cross-project traffic.
raj: we should add a fallback model routing policy in case H100 capacity isn't granted — route to quantized A100 variant in us-central1. Put that in the ticket so support can approve partial fallback.
maya: tagging note for the ticket: "env=prod, team=infra, urgency=high, cost_center=ML-OPS-2026"
alex: done. I've added the ticket comment with cost breakdown and preemptible plan. Ticket ID INC-2026-442.
infra-bot: Google response queued. Status: pending review by Google quota team. ETA ~ 24-48 hours.
francesco: approved from finance side pending confirmation of actual monthly charge after provisioning. Approve if ticket is approved.
alex: thanks — will follow up. If approved, next steps: create IAM service account for pool provisioning (sa:pool-provisioner@redwood-ml-prod-02.iam.gserviceaccount.com), then run terraform apply (module: gcp-gpu-pools).
raj: remind infra team to add egress firewall rules to restrict ports for the pool and document firewall in confluence (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INFRA).
maya: tagging @sre for runbook update once nodes are live.
sre: noted — will add healthchecks, autoreplace policies, and HL metrics dashboards.
alex: will post back here when the quota is approved or if Google requests more justification.
